name: daynote
description: Daynote - a little space for your thoughts. A full-stack personal journaling app.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,web -c yellow,magenta,green "npm run mongo --prefix backend" "node backend/scripts/wait-for-mongo.cjs && npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
